description: Repository identifier, never changed: RUN-, the newspaper (ZA or GG) and the reference number in Bergemann's dataset (RUN-ZA-001 is ZA1, RUN-GG-114a is GG114a)
De Zuid Afrikaan or the (Cape of Good Hope) Government Gazette
Date the advertisement was published
Name of the person who fled, as printed
M or F, as recorded
Age in years as stated in the advertisement
Year of flight, where the advertisement states or implies it
Month of flight (1-12)
Time between flight and advertisement, as transcribed (y years, m months, w weeks, d days)
Origin or ethnic description as printed, e.g. Mozambique, Cape, Prize Negro
Identity the person was said to pass as or resemble
Physical description
Other traits or demeanour
Clothing worn or taken
Other items taken
Skills, occupation and languages as printed
The advertiser's supposition about where the person went or what they intended
Sightings after flight
Location given in the advertisement, usually the advertiser's home or farm
Enslaver or person who placed the advertisement, as transcribed (surname, initials)
Reward as printed (Rd/Rds = rixdollars; pound sterling); editorial notes in brackets
Transcription of the advertisement, with some shorthand; given once, on the first person, where one advertisement names several people
